unplugged.100.zh: 开局：击毁围攻母星的机械舰队
unplugged.100.en: Game start: destroy the machine fleet over the homeworld

unplugged.3205.zh: 与一个畏惧本帝国的文明建立通讯时（仅一次）
unplugged.3205.en: On establishing communications with an empire that fears you (once)

unplugged.3250.zh: 首次与非同化者的机械帝国通讯
unplugged.3250.en: First communications with a machine empire that is not an assimilator

unplugged.3255.zh: 首次与同化者机械帝国通讯
unplugged.3255.en: First communications with a Driven Assimilator

unplugged.4005.zh: 尚无派系时的年度检查（3/5机会，20天后）
unplugged.4005.en: Yearly check while no factions exist (3 in 5 chance, 20 days later)

unplugged.2495.zh: 舰队首次进入有作品哨兵驻守的机械核心星系
unplugged.2495.en: A fleet first enters the machine core system guarded by the Opus Sentinel

opening.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:66 on_game_start_country -> hidden unplugged.199 (events/unplugged_events.txt:25-103) spawns the hostile machine fleet over the capital; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1688 on_fleet_destroyed_perp -> 100 (events/unplugged_events.txt:249-318). common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2275-2276 on_post_communications_established -> hidden 3200 / 3249 (events/unplugged_events.txt:3283-3394) -> 3205 / 3250 / 3255. common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:423 on_yearly_pulse_country -> hidden 4000 (events/unplugged_events.txt:4002-4018) -> unplugged_spawn_factions_check (common/scripted_effects/unplugged_effects.txt:626-635, 3/5 -> 4005 after 20 days). common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1072 on_entering_system_fleet -> 2495 (events/unplugged_events.txt:2557-2601). common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1174 on_survey_planet -> hidden 198 (events/unplugged_events.txt:106-217): non-Unplugged surveyors get the anomaly categories MACHINE_LEGACY_*_CAT.

label.zh: 勘察标记的工厂世界（已勘察则立即出现）
label.en: Survey the marked Makers world (at once if already surveyed)

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:338-369 2000 adds the anomaly at once if the planet is surveyed, otherwise a POI; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1174 on_survey_planet -> hidden 198 (events/unplugged_events.txt:134-159) adds MACHINE_LEGACY_MAKERS_UNPLUGGED_CAT for an Unplugged surveyor.

label.zh: 本帝国击毁该舰队
label.en: Your empire destroys the fleet

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1598 on_fleet_destroyed_victim -> hidden 2035 (events/unplugged_events.txt:707-735): fleet machine_legacy_makers_fleet destroyed -> 2036 for the destroyer if it is this Unplugged empire (events/unplugged_events.txt:738-783).

label.zh: 其他帝国击毁该舰队
label.en: Another empire destroys the fleet

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:719-733 2035 sends 2037 to every other Unplugged empire (events/unplugged_events.txt:786-791).

label.zh: 勘察标记的被同化者世界（科研船，90天）
label.en: Survey the marked world of the Taken (science ship, 90 days)

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:760-769 2036 creates unplugged_machine_legacy_taken_poi; hidden 198 (events/unplugged_events.txt:160-185) enables MACHINE_LEGACY_TAKEN_UNPLUGGED (common/special_projects/04_projects_unplugged.txt:1-18) for an Unplugged surveyor.

label.zh: 勘察标记的被同化者世界（科研船，90天）
label.en: Survey the marked world of the Taken (science ship, 90 days)

label.zh: 勘察标记的被同化者世界（科研船，90天）
label.en: Survey the marked world of the Taken (science ship, 90 days)

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:818-827 2038 creates the same POI; events/unplugged_events.txt:160-185.

label.zh: 勘察标记的创造者世界（科研船，90天）
label.en: Survey the marked world of the Creators (science ship, 90 days)

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:1172-1181 2130 creates unplugged_machine_legacy_creators_poi; hidden 198 (events/unplugged_events.txt:186-211) enables MACHINE_LEGACY_CREATORS_UNPLUGGED (common/special_projects/04_projects_unplugged.txt:20-37).

label.zh: 首次进入创造者星系360天后：数据金库的信号
label.en: 360 days after first entering the Creators system: the data vault signal

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:946 on_entering_system_first_time -> hidden 2204 (events/unplugged_events.txt:1358-1385) schedules 2205 after 360 days (events/unplugged_events.txt:1388-1425).

label.zh: 舰队进入标记的星系
label.en: A fleet enters the marked system

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:1402-1411 2205 creates unplugged_machine_legacy_unplugged_poi; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1071 on_entering_system_fleet -> 2300 (events/unplugged_events.txt:1499-1552) requires that POI.

label.zh: 击毁拦截舰队
label.en: Destroy the intercepting fleet

label.zh: 在机械核心击毁作品哨兵
label.en: Destroy the Opus Sentinel at the machine core

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:1889-1896 2390 marks the core; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1690 on_fleet_destroyed_perp -> hidden 2400 (events/unplugged_events.txt:1918-1954) -> 2401 if this Unplugged empire destroyed it.

label.zh: 另一帝国击毁了作品哨兵
label.en: Another empire destroys the Opus Sentinel

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:1944-1952 2400 sends 2402 to every other Unplugged empire (events/unplugged_events.txt:1980-2000).

label.zh: 项目进度25%：工厂档案（需完成工厂遗址）
label.en: At 25%: the Makers archive (Makers site completed)

label.en: (Other empires' view) when another empire surveys the same Makers world

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:106-217 hidden 198 (on_survey_planet, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1174): a surveyor without this origin gets the anomaly category MACHINE_LEGACY_MAKERS_CAT on the same planet instead.

bridges.evidence: events/unplugged_events.txt:106-217 hidden 198 (on_survey_planet, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1174): a surveyor without this origin gets the anomaly category MACHINE_LEGACY_TAKEN_CAT on the same planet instead.

notes.zh: 审阅注：局势每1800–1920天按当时所处阶段选择对应路线的下一步（去义体化0–35、维持现状35–65、义体化65–100）。阶段在两次检查之间改变时会转到另一路线，原路线的进度保留；图中只画出每条路线自身的顺序。
notes.en: Review note: every 1800-1920 days the situation takes the next step of the track matching its current stage (decyberize 0-35, status quo 35-65, cyberize 65-100). If the stage changes between checks the next step comes from the other track, and each track keeps its progress; the map only draws each track's own order.

notes.zh: 审阅注：遗址各阶段在编译图中按定义顺序相连；第三阶段的两个结果（2021/2022）实为二选一，见互斥组。
notes.en: Review note: the compiled map chains all site stages in definition order; the two stage-3 results (2021/2022) are alternatives, see the exclusive group.

scope.zh: 核对开局内战与故土遗址、机械遗产五个星系的全部事件/项目/遗址、作品之核对话与两个结局、身份局势三条路线与随机后果、外交与派系插曲，以及其他帝国视角的窗口。
scope.en: Checked the opening civil war and the Ruined Cradle dig, every event/project/site of the five Machine Legacy systems, the Opus Nexus dialogue and both endings, the three identity-situation tracks and their random follow-ups, the diplomacy and faction interludes, and the windows seen by other empires.

uncertain: The compiler chains archaeology stage outcomes in definition order (2015 -> 2021 -> 2022, 2115 -> 2125 ... 2121, 2315 -> 2321 -> 2325); the stage-3 gatekeepers 2020/2120/2320 actually pick one of two. Recorded as exclusive groups; needs a compiler fix (ledger R5).
Identity-situation cross-track switches are described, not drawn (reading simplification, see suppress evidence).
